title: Consolidations
subtitle: Paid orders on the same carrier service, sent together. Each customer pays transport as if their order went alone; Tracecart pays the carrier once, for the whole load.
carrierSubtitle: Orders Tracecart hands you together: one pickup, one load, one set of updates. Delivery stays order by order.
failed: That didn't go through. Try again.

suggestions.empty: Nothing to consolidate yet: it takes at least two paid orders on the same service.
